definition: The task of identifying and classifying the semantic relationships between entities mentioned in text.
details: Relation extraction is often paired with entity extraction to automatically construct or populate knowledge graphs from unstructured documents.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Relation Extraction — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
